source.directorySummary: Implements the file restore command that restores a single workspace-relative git file to HEAD via git restore, deleting untracked/newly-added files and re-checking tracked files.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Adapter extracts file from jsonPayload or parsed arguments and repositoryPath, resolves workspace root, and returns restoreGitFile result text or a validation error string.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Defines restore subcommand metadata with name restore, summary about restoring one changed file to HEAD or deleting if untracked, and a required workspace-relative file string argument.

handler.ts.sourceSummary: Implements workspace-contained restore via path validation, HEAD tracking check with git cat-file, staged unstage with git restore --staged, and deletion or git restore to HEAD.

summary.value: Implements the file restore command that restores a single workspace-relative git file to HEAD via git restore, deleting untracked/newly-added files and re-checking tracked files.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Git-undo leaf within the plugins/file/commands git-operations family alongside diff/history/commit/init, fanned out from the centralized file plugin dispatcher (adapter.ts/handleFile) and init registration. Complements observational git commands by providing targeted single-file HEAD revert for both CLI and web tree/file views, following the file/git shared pipeline of validate workspace containment → execute git CLI → adapt to text rendering, without participating in the bottom-up hash-cache/plan-draft-accept modal lifecycle.

files.adapter.ts: CLI/web adaptation shim for the restore subcommand — extracts the workspace-relative file target from jsonPayload or parsed args with repositoryPath fallback, resolves workspace root via shared helper, delegates to handler's restoreGitFile, and normalizes success/error to text for the dispatcher/bot response. Thin bridging layer consistent with other file/git command adapters.
files.definition.ts: Declarative registration contract that exposes restore to the file plugin's command parser, dispatcher, and help renderer. Defines the single required workspace-relative file argument and summary string, establishing the invocation shape validated by adapter/handler and surfaced in help without containing execution logic.
files.handler.ts: Core execution engine owning containment and mutation logic — validates workspace boundary, probes HEAD tracking via git cat-file -e to branch between delete-if-untracked and unstage-via-restore---staged plus restore-to-HEAD, encapsulating all git CLI side effects and path-safety guarantees isolated from adapter rendering.
